text: gave judgment upon him: Heb. spake with him judgments
with chains: Heb. with two brasen chains, or fetters
the captain of the guard: Or, chief Marshal. Heb. chief of the executioners or slaughtermen. And so verse 10. 11, etc.
at the same time: Heb. in that day
to: Heb. by the hand of
look well to him: Heb. set thine eyes upon him
